findings.title: Split queries interpolate variable values more than once
findings.description:
The new interpolation passes already-expanded targets to `datasource.runQuery()`. That calls `DataSourceWithBackend.query()`, which applies template variables again (`packages/grafana-runtime/src/utils/DataSourceWithBackend.ts:185`). Shard splitting adds another interpolation pass.

Interpolation is not idempotent: given `{app="x"} |= "$search"`, with `search` containing literal `$other` and `other` set to `replacement`, the backend receives a search for `replacement` instead of `$other`. Previously, ordinary time-split queries interpolated only once.

Use interpolated targets for partitioning without re-interpolating their values during execution. Add a regression test through the real `runQuery()` path; the added tests mock that method and therefore miss this defect.

structured_findings.summary: Split queries interpolate variable values more than once
